principle.name: THE FLOOR CAN BORROW A JOINT
principle.pocket_rule: WHEN A HEAVY TOOL HITS, FREEZE THE CONTACT LONG ENOUGH FOR THE BODY TO SPEND FORCE THROUGH IT; THEN LET THE TOOL REBOUND BEFORE THE ROOT RECOVERS.
principle.fresh_interpretation: A heavy diagonal drop is authored as two opposing clocks. The body commits down-forward first, the tool catches up into explicit precontact and contact, the head remains pinned while the pelvis compresses past it, then the head rebounds high-rear while the root still overruns. Recovery catches the returning tool late and settles in a wider forward-debt stance instead of reversing to ready.

keys.name: CANTED_READY
keys.causal_role: unequal neutral: tool already biases the rear shoulder so later recoil has a distinct home
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis low-left of chest; hammer floats forward-diagonal without commitment

keys.name: REAR_SINK
keys.causal_role: support/root sink creates room for the tool to travel without beginning the strike
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis drops back-left; front heel rises; hammer climbs but remains in front of the shoulder

keys.name: CROSS_BODY_COIL
keys.causal_role: deep asymmetrical coil stores the hammer behind the body and opens a large right-side negative space
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis stays rear/down while both hands cross left; hammer head clears behind the rear shoulder

keys.name: ROOT_DROP_BRIDGE
keys.causal_role: body-first authored bridge: pelvis steps down-forward while the hammer is deliberately withheld
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root moves four cells toward impact before hammer head advances; torso leans into the empty lane

keys.name: TOOL_COMMIT
keys.causal_role: hammer finally escapes after the root earns the lane
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis surges right/up slightly; hands uncross; hammer head sweeps across the top arc

keys.name: PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: distinct precontact one beat before impact; tool is near target but not touching
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root remains behind hands; hammer head descends to a visible one-step gap above the impact post

keys.name: IMPACT_CONTACT
keys.causal_role: explicit authored contact instant; not merely the farthest tool reach
keys.motion_arc_root_note: hammer head enters the impact cell while pelvis changes minimally from precontact; hit-stop only implied

keys.name: PINNED_BODY_COMPRESSION
keys.causal_role: fixed tool contact becomes a temporary joint while the body spends force through it
keys.motion_arc_root_note: hammer head remains fixed; pelvis drops three cells and advances; rear heel peels and shoulders stack behind handle

keys.name: SPRING_REBOUND
keys.causal_role: contact releases and the hammer rebounds opposite the still-forward body clock
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues right/down while tool head snaps high-rear; body and tool are visibly not reversing together

keys.name: ROOT_OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: body overshoots after the tool has already reversed, preserving force debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis advances past contact line of action; hammer remains high-rear; rear leg trails clear of ground

keys.name: REAR_FOOT_CATCH
keys.causal_role: support catches the overrunning root before the hammer is recovered
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis drops back one cell; rear foot lands wide; hammer head falls behind shoulder on a delayed secondary clock

keys.name: TOOL_LAG_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: tool debt remains after body catch; low rear head keeps the silhouette crooked
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis stabilizes but hammer continues down-rear; shoulders stay canted and hands do not return to K0

keys.name: DISPLACED_READY_DEBT
keys.causal_role: settle ends in a usable but visibly spent state rather than neutral reset
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis remains far right of K0, stance stays wider, hammer is low-rear and body lean remains asymmetric
